list: Rogue Traders — Pirates and Wolf Packs

rules.key: All pirate vessels suffer a -1 leadership modifier
rules.text: All pirate vessels suffer a -1 leadership modifier, meaning their unmodified starting leadership will be from 5 to 8.

rules.key: Pirate fleets have an attack or initiative rating of 3
rules.text: Pirate fleets have an attack or initiative rating of 3.

rules.key: If a pirate fleet has more than 750 points of ships, a Pirate Captain must lead it
rules.text: If a pirate fleet has more than 750 points of ships, a Pirate Captain must lead it.
rules.why: Kolmas sanamuoto samalle saannolle: 'has more than'. Kirja kayttaa muualla muotoja 'worth over' ja 'is above'. Kaikki kolme lisattiin MAND_GT-kaavaan 7.9.2026, ja lisaksi MAND_LEADS piti laajentaa muotoon 'must lead it' - kirjassa lukee 'must lead it', ei 'to lead it'.

rules.key: A Pirate Captain may be embarked on a cruiser for every 500 points or portion thereof
rules.text: A Pirate Captain may be embarked on a cruiser for every 500 points or portion thereof in a fleet.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. Osioraja 0-3 sailyy rinnalla. Aiempi puute: Pisterajaan sidottu maara. Osioraja 0-3 on valvottu, mutta pienissa laivastoissa todellinen raja on tiukempi: 500 pisteessa vain yksi kapteeni.

rules.key: may purchase up to two more re-rolls for +25 points each
rules.text: A Pirate Captain gets one re-roll, and may purchase up to two more re-rolls for +25 points each.
rules.why: Hinnoiteltu optio; rivit 'One extra re-roll 25' ja 'Two extra re-rolls 50' ovat valittavissa.

rules.key: He (or she!) must be placed aboard the most expensive vessel in the fleet
rules.text: He (or she!) must be placed aboard the most expensive vessel in the fleet (or vessels if more than one Captain is present).

rules.key: A human pirate fleet may have up to one cruiser for every 500 points of ships
rules.text: A human pirate fleet may have up to one cruiser for every 500 points of ships in the fleet or portion thereof.
rules.why: Risteilijat valitaan kirjan mukaan toisista listoista (Imperial/Chaos <= 185 pts); talla listalla ei ole risteilijariveja, joten laskettavaa ei ole. Listojen valinen valinta on v1.1.

rules.key: A Pirate Cruiser may consist of a Rogue Trader cruiser or any cruiser from the Imperial or Chaos fleet lists worth 185 points or less
rules.text: A Pirate Cruiser may consist of a Rogue Trader cruiser or any cruiser from the Imperial or Chaos fleet lists worth 185 points or less. It may also include a single Space Marine strike cruiser! Special variants, refits and Nova Cannons cannot be used.
rules.why: Alukset tulevat toisista listoista hintarajan perusteella. Tama on koko kirjan avoimin listamaarittely: sita ei voi esittaa riveina ilman etta koko Imperial- ja Chaos-valikoima kopioitaisiin tanne.

rules.key: At least one squadron of 3–6 escort vessels must be included for each cruiser
rules.text: At least one squadron of 3-6 escort vessels must be included for each cruiser in the fleet, organized in any mix desired.
rules.why: Skwadronin koko 3-6 on valvottu. Vaatimus 'vahintaan yksi skwadroni per risteilija' ei ole - se on eri saantotyyppi.

rules.key: The number of escort vessels that utilize ordnance or lance weaponry may not outnumber
rules.text: The number of escort vessels that utilize ordnance or lance weaponry may not outnumber those that rely solely on weapon batteries.
rules.why: Jako tehdaan aseistuksen perusteella (ordnance/lanssi vs. pelkat patterit). Ratkaisin tuntee aserivit, mutta 'rely solely on weapon batteries' vaatii aseluokituksen jokaiselle escort-profiilille - v1.1.

rules.key: Up to 10% of a pirate fleet may be made up of alien escorts
rules.text: Up to 10% of a pirate fleet may be made up of alien escorts from any race except Tyranids, Necrons or vessels that require support from a capital ship of their race.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. points_share: Xenos-rivien pisteet <= 10 % laivaston pisteista. Aiempi puute: Prosenttiosuus laivaston pisteista. Moottorissa ei ole osuusrajaa.

rules.key: vessels of different races may not combine with each other into a single squadron
rules.text: They can be organized in squadrons of two to six ships, but vessels of different races may not combine with each other into a single squadron, nor can they combine into squadrons with human (Imperial, Chaos or Rogue Trader) vessels.

rules.key: They may not use any of a Pirate Captain’s re-rolls
rules.text: Xenos freebooters and corsairs have no allegiance to the human pirates they serve alongside. They may not use any of a Pirate Captain's re-rolls, and will automatically attempt to disengage if the escort squadron is crippled.

extra_entries.name: Imperial Power Ram (6+ prow, not with a Nova Cannon)

notes: Kirja merkitsee Fra'al Battleshipin '(0-2)', josta sovellus asettaa rivirajan mx=2. Kirja lisaa: 'These count as cruisers for fleet building.'
Idolator Raiderin sivuviite on kirjassa vaarin (s. 147); oikea profiili on sivulla 281. Sovellus korjaa taman nimen perusteella ja kertoo sen rivin huomautuksessa.
'Cargo Transport (pg. 85)' osoittaa Imperial Navyn TRANSPORT-profiiliin. Sovellus osoitti sen aiemmin virheellisesti sivulle 192; korjattu 7.9.2026.

Tama lista on rakenteeltaan avoin: varsinaisia risteilijarivaja ei ole lainkaan, koska kirja maarittelee ne hintarajalla toisista listoista. Se selittaa miksi valvottuja saantoja on kolme mutta puutteita nelja.
